        OF CAPACITY PURCHASE AGREEMENTS                           )
        PURSUANT 17 O.S. § 286(C)                                 )

                     WITHDRAWAL OF OBJECTIONS TO DISCOVERY REQUESTS

              COMES NOW Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company (“OG&E” or the “Company”) and hereby

       withdraws its Objections to Discovery Requests filed herein on August 5, 2026. The objections

       concerned certain requests contained in the Public Utility Division’s Ninth Data Request to Oklahoma

       Gas and Electric Company, including questions 9-1 through 9-5, 9-7, and 9-9.

              The discovery issues set forth in the Objections have been resolved. Accordingly, OG&E

       withdraws the Objections and no longer requests a ruling by the Commission on those Objections.

       OG&E further requests that the hearing on the Objections currently set for August 13, 2026, at 8:30

       a.m. be stricken from the docket.
